summary: Remotes in Automation Content > Remotes sync private automation hub with certified content on console.redhat.com (rh-certified) or Galaxy (community); Galaxy content is community with no joint support, hub content targets subscribed customers; request a Galaxy namespace by emailing ansiblepartners@redhat.com with your GitHub username.
